title: Cinema and Narrative Worlds
description: Examines cinema as a medium of narrative expression and imagination across different aesthetic, cultural and historical contexts. Focuses on how filmmakers use story, image and sound to explore experiences of identity, power, conflict and change. Emphasis on narrative analysis and theoretical approaches within English studies.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of ENSH 327, ENSH 320 (if taken in Fall 2023, Fall 2024 or Fall 2025).
